verdict.rationale: smolagents is a library for building agents, not an app with an embedded assistant. It does let users hand tasks to agents with little setup: `agent.run("<task>")`, ready-made CLI agents (`smolagent`, `webagent`) that need no boilerplate, and default tools such as web search. The assistant is still something the user assembles and configures rather than one living inside a product UI. Missing for 10: a true built-in in-product assistant experience, documentation of the CLI agents' delegation workflow beyond a one-line mention, and independent hands-on corroboration of delegating real tasks end-to-end.
